use.known: My mother likes to help people with their work.
use.target: 我妈妈喜欢帮人做他们的工作。

use.known: That young man asked me if I know your brother.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人问我是不是认识你哥哥。

use.known: If the old woman can tell me, I would be very happy.
use.target: 如果那个老女人能告诉我的话，我会很开心。

use.known: Everyone told me they want to meet your sister too.
use.target: 大家都告诉我他们也想见你姐姐。

use.known: Would that young woman be able to help me with this?
use.target: 那个年轻的女人能帮我做这个吗？

use.known: She hopes I can remember what the old man said.
use.target: 她希望我能记住那个老人说了什么。

use.known: My mother likes to read when she has time.
use.target: 我妈妈有时间的时候喜欢看书。

use.known: That young man said his mother wants to meet you.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人说他妈妈想见你。

use.known: If your mother can come tomorrow, we can all talk.
use.target: 如果你妈妈明天能来的话，我们大家可以说话。

use.known: She told me her mother remembers what happened.
use.target: 她告诉我她妈妈记住发生了什么。

use.known: Everyone here wants to meet your mother someday.
use.target: 这里的大家都想有一天见你妈妈。

use.known: Does your mother still want to work together with us?
use.target: 你妈妈还想和我们一起工作吗？

use.known: My mother likes to read books about many things.
use.target: 我妈妈喜欢看很多东西的书。

use.known: That young woman likes to practise speaking with us.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人喜欢和我们练习说话。

use.known: If you like this kind of work, you should do it.
use.target: 如果你喜欢这样的工作的话，你要做。

use.known: He told me he likes to help people when he can.
use.target: 他告诉我他能的时候喜欢帮人。

use.known: Everyone here likes to learn new things together.
use.target: 这里的大家都喜欢一起学新的东西。

use.known: What kind of things does your sister like to do?
use.target: 你姐姐喜欢做什么样的东西？

use.known: My mother likes to read at night before she sleeps.
use.target: 我妈妈喜欢晚上睡觉以前看书。

use.known: That young man likes to read when he has time.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人有时间的时候喜欢看书。

use.known: If you want to learn more, you should read a lot.
use.target: 如果你想学更多的话，你要看很多书。

use.known: She told me her brother likes to read about work.
use.target: 她告诉我她哥哥喜欢看工作的书。

use.known: Everyone here should read more to learn new things.
use.target: 这里的大家要更多看书来学新的东西。

use.known: Do you like to read books with your sister?
use.target: 你喜欢和你姐姐一起看书吗？
